title: 11 November 2010: Paul McCartney live at River Plate Stadium, Buenos Aires, Argentina
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the River Plate Stadium in Buenos Aires, Argentina, on 11 November 2010.

It was the 28th concert of the Up And Coming Tour, which lasted for 38 dates between March 2010 and June 2011, and the second of two consecutive nights in Buenos Aires.

Instead of beginning with the usual ‘Venus And Mars’/‘Rock Show’, McCartney began with a version of The Beatles’ ‘Magical Mystery Tour’. He also inserted the Band On The Run song ‘Bluebird’ into the middle of the show.

Here’s the performance of ‘Live And Let Die’:

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the Estadio River Plate on 10, 11, and 12 December 1993 during the New World Tour. He returned there on 5 and 6 October 2024.
